lines.zh: 这双腿不是我的，可它们在走。
lines.en: These legs aren't mine, yet they walk.

lines.zh: 我听见有人在里面笑。
lines.en: I hear someone laughing inside me.

lines.zh: 身子自己转向那边，我拦不住。
lines.en: My body turns that way on its own. I can't stop it.

lines.zh: 一步一步，很稳，稳得不像我。
lines.en: Step by step, steady — too steady to be me.

lines.zh: 眼睛看出去，颜色不太对。
lines.en: Everything looks the wrong color through these eyes.

lines.zh: 我不记得自己想去哪。
lines.en: I don't remember where I wanted to go.

lines.zh: 手指在动，可我没下令。
lines.en: My fingers move and I gave no order.

lines.zh: 这具身体比从前轻。
lines.en: This body feels lighter than before.

lines.zh: 我绕开人群，走得更远。
lines.en: I skirt the crowd and go further out.

lines.zh: 背后的声音一直没停。
lines.en: The voice behind me hasn't stopped.

lines.zh: 我走路的姿势，像另一个人。
lines.en: I walk like someone else.

lines.zh: 别靠太近，我不确定谁在控制。
lines.en: Don't come close. I'm not sure who's in control.

lines.zh: 我站着，像被钉在原地。
lines.en: I stand as if nailed to the spot.

lines.zh: 安静的时候，能听见两个呼吸。
lines.en: In the quiet I hear two breaths.

lines.zh: 我低下头，看着自己的手。
lines.en: I look down at my own hands.

lines.zh: 这手背上，多了些纹路。
lines.en: There are new markings on the back of my hand.

lines.zh: 它让我别动，我就动不了。
lines.en: It tells me to be still, and I can't move.

lines.zh: 记忆一段一段的，接不上。
lines.en: My memories come in pieces that don't join.

lines.zh: 我试着喊，可出不了声。
lines.en: I try to shout, but nothing comes out.

lines.zh: 这身体在笑，我没想笑。
lines.en: This body is smiling. I didn't mean to.

lines.zh: 有东西在心里翻，很冷。
lines.en: Something turns inside my chest. Cold.

lines.zh: 我数着自己的心跳，数乱了。
lines.en: I count my heartbeats and lose the count.

lines.zh: 它说要复仇，我不懂。
lines.en: It says revenge. I don't understand.

lines.zh: 我张了张嘴，发不出原来的声音。
lines.en: I open my mouth and my own voice is gone.

lines.zh: 这具身体，暂时借给它。
lines.en: This body is lent to it for now.

lines.zh: 我还能想起来，就还没全丢。
lines.en: If I can still remember, not all is lost.

lines.zh: 你在看谁？看我还是看它？
lines.en: Who are you looking at — me or it?

lines.zh: 我的眼睛，现在不是我的颜色。
lines.en: These eyes aren't my color anymore.

lines.zh: 你退后，我怕它突然动。
lines.en: Get back. I fear it will move suddenly.

lines.zh: 你认得我吗？我认得你。
lines.en: Do you know me? I know you.

lines.zh: 我的嘴在动，可话不是我说的。
lines.en: My mouth is moving, but the words aren't mine.

lines.zh: 它对你很感兴趣，这不是好事。
lines.en: It's interested in you. That's not good.

lines.zh: 站着别动，让我看清你。
lines.en: Stand still and let me look at you.

lines.zh: 我抬手，这次是我自己抬的。
lines.en: I raise my hand. This time it's my own.

lines.zh: 你别信我说的话。
lines.en: Don't trust what I say.

lines.zh: 这一身气不是我挑的。
lines.en: This aura wasn't my choice.

lines.zh: 它在借我的眼睛看你。
lines.en: It's borrowing my eyes to look at you.

lines.zh: 你要是听见我喊，就跑。
lines.en: If you hear me shout, run.

lines.zh: 我咬了下舌头，确认还醒着。
lines.en: I bite my tongue to check I'm awake.

lines.zh: 这张脸，还是我的吧。
lines.en: This face is still mine, isn't it.

lines.zh: 别伸手，我的手会自己动。
lines.en: Don't reach out. My hand moves on its own.

lines.zh: 我盯着你，也盯着我自己。
lines.en: I'm watching you, and watching myself too.

lines.zh: 它想说话，我压着它。
lines.en: It wants to speak. I'm holding it down.

lines.zh: 刚才那一瞬，我的声音回来了。
lines.en: For a moment there, my voice came back.

lines.zh: 疼，这疼是我自己的。
lines.en: Pain. This pain is mine.

lines.zh: 它退了退，让我疼一会儿。
lines.en: It pulled back and let me hurt.

lines.zh: 我借这个疼，清醒了一下。
lines.en: I use the pain to clear my head.

lines.zh: 别停手，它怕这个。
lines.en: Don't stop — it fears this.

lines.zh: 血是我的，颜色对得上。
lines.en: The blood is mine. The color's right.

lines.zh: 我跪下来，又撑着站起。
lines.en: I drop to a knee and push back up.

lines.zh: 它在我耳朵里骂。
lines.en: It's cursing in my ear.

lines.zh: 这一下，把它的声音打散了。
lines.en: That blow scattered its voice.

lines.zh: 我摸到伤口，是热的。
lines.en: I touch the wound. It's warm.

lines.zh: 再打一下，也许我就自由了。
lines.en: Hit me again. Maybe then I'm free.

lines.zh: 我饿，但不是我想吃。
lines.en: I'm hungry, but it's not me who wants to eat.

lines.zh: 你拿远点，它闻到味道了。
lines.en: Hold it further away. It smelled it.

lines.zh: 我的手伸过去了，不是我。
lines.en: My hand reached out. It wasn't me.

lines.zh: 吃一口，也许能压住它。
lines.en: One bite might keep it down.

lines.zh: 这身体要养分，很急。
lines.en: This body needs fuel, urgently.

lines.zh: 我尝不出味道了。
lines.en: I can't taste anything anymore.

lines.zh: 你自己吃吧，别给我。
lines.en: You eat it. Don't give it to me.

lines.zh: 它喜欢这个，我感觉得到。
lines.en: It likes this. I can feel it.

lines.zh: 被附身的手，先藏到背后。
lines.en: Possessed hands, tucked behind my back.

lines.zh: 让开点，我怕咬到你的手。
lines.en: Stay clear — I might bite your hand.

lines.zh: 别碰我，碰了它就醒了。
lines.en: Don't touch me; it wakes when touched.

lines.zh: 这一撞，让它高兴了。
lines.en: That bump pleased it.

lines.zh: 我退开，用尽力气才退开。
lines.en: I pull back — it takes all my strength.

lines.zh: 你的肩膀撞在我身上，很冷吧。
lines.en: Your shoulder hit me. Cold, isn't it.

lines.zh: 对不起，刚才不是我在推你。
lines.en: Sorry — that wasn't me pushing.

lines.zh: 我们撞上，两个声音同时响。
lines.en: We collide and two voices speak at once.

lines.zh: 我扶着墙站稳，慢慢喘。
lines.en: I brace against the wall and breathe slowly.

lines.zh: 别贴着我站，离远一点。
lines.en: Don't stand against me. Move away.

lines.zh: 我的影子在动，可我没动。
lines.en: My shadow moves and I don't.

lines.zh: 让路，我得走开。
lines.en: Let me pass. I need to get away.

lines.zh: 这不合适，我现在不太对。
lines.en: This isn't right. I'm not myself.

lines.zh: 它也在听，我不想让它听。
lines.en: It's listening too. I don't want it to.

lines.zh: 你把话说轻一点。
lines.en: Speak more softly.

lines.zh: 我记得有人这样靠近过我。
lines.en: I remember someone coming close like this.

lines.zh: 别牵我的手，它太冷了。
lines.en: Don't take my hand; it's too cold.

lines.zh: 如果我还清醒，我会答应。
lines.en: If I'm still myself, I'd say yes.

lines.zh: 这身体不属于我，我不能许你什么。
lines.en: This body isn't mine. I can't promise you anything.

lines.zh: 你走吧，别留在这。
lines.en: Go. Don't stay here.

lines.zh: 我听见它在你名字后面笑。
lines.en: I hear it laughing after your name.

lines.zh: 要走的话，现在就走。
lines.en: If you're leaving, leave now.

lines.zh: 我捡起来，又扔掉了。
lines.en: I pick it up and throw it away.

lines.zh: 手自己合拢，我没让它。
lines.en: My hand closed on its own.

lines.zh: 这是你的东西吗？拿回去。
lines.en: Is this yours? Take it back.

lines.zh: 它在争这只手，很疼。
lines.en: It's fighting me for this hand. It hurts.

lines.zh: 我握紧，再松开，确认能松开。
lines.en: I grip, then release, to prove I can.

lines.zh: 地上那枚，我看不清颜色。
lines.en: That thing on the ground — I can't tell the color.

lines.zh: 别把东西递给我，别递。
lines.en: Don't hand me things. Don't.

lines.zh: 我把它放回原处，放得很慢。
lines.en: I set it back down, very slowly.

lines.zh: 这重量，让我的手稳了一点。
lines.en: The weight steadied my hand a little.

lines.zh: 我拿着它，装作没事。
lines.en: I hold it and pretend nothing's wrong.

lines.zh: 它看见你了，比我先。
lines.en: It saw you before I did.

lines.zh: 我的头自己转过去。
lines.en: My head turns by itself.

lines.zh: 走，趁我还能压住它。
lines.en: Go. While I can still hold it.

lines.zh: 这不是我的杀意。
lines.en: This killing intent isn't mine.

lines.zh: 我的手抬起来了，不是我抬的。
lines.en: My hand is up. I didn't raise it.

lines.zh: 它在挑目标，我拦不住。
lines.en: It's choosing a target. I can't stop it.

lines.zh: 气变了颜色，你看见了吧。
lines.en: The aura changed color. You see it, don't you.

lines.zh: 我压着，压得很吃力。
lines.en: I'm holding it down. Barely.

lines.zh: 我听见自己的声音在倒数。
lines.en: I hear my own voice counting down.

lines.zh: 别站在那，快跑。
lines.en: Don't stand there. Run.

lines.zh: 这一下，是我自己想打。
lines.en: This one — I want to throw it.

lines.zh: 它笑了，笑得很开心。
lines.en: It laughed. It sounded pleased.

lines.zh: 我最后说一次：走。
lines.en: Last time: go.

lines.zh: 身体已经往前倾了。
lines.en: My body is already leaning forward.

lines.zh: 我看得清你，它看得更清。
lines.en: I see you clearly. It sees you clearer.

lines.zh: 来不及了，别怪我。
lines.en: Too late. Don't blame me.

lines.zh: 它一直盯着，我推不开。
lines.en: It keeps staring. I can't push it aside.

lines.zh: 我用两只手按住自己的手腕。
lines.en: I hold my own wrist down with both hands.

lines.zh: 这眼睛自己不眨。
lines.en: These eyes won't blink.

lines.zh: 它在算你的距离，很准。
lines.en: It's measuring your distance. Very precisely.

lines.zh: 我数自己的呼吸，怕它太快。
lines.en: I count my breaths, afraid they'll race.

lines.zh: 你别动，动了它就会上。
lines.en: Don't move. If you move, it attacks.

lines.zh: 被附身的身体，力气不太听话。
lines.en: This possessed body won't obey.

lines.zh: 这身体的重心，它调得比我好。
lines.en: It balances this body better than I do.

lines.zh: 有东西在我喉咙里说话。
lines.en: Something is speaking in my throat.

lines.zh: 我退了一步，它又往前走一步。
lines.en: I step back and it walks me forward again.

lines.zh: 别看我，看别的地方。
lines.en: Don't look at me. Look elsewhere.

lines.zh: 它喜欢这种对峙。
lines.en: It enjoys a standoff like this.

lines.zh: 我还能动一半，够用了。
lines.en: I can still move half of me. That's enough.

lines.zh: 你的位置，我记得很清楚。
lines.en: I remember exactly where you are.

lines.zh: 我咬着牙，把拳头压在身侧。
lines.en: I clench my jaw and pin my fist to my side.

lines.zh: 再来一会儿，我就撑不住了。
lines.en: A little longer and I can't hold it.

lines.zh: 我说不出话，只能用眼睛。
lines.en: I can't speak. Only my eyes.

lines.zh: 它在等你先动。
lines.en: It's waiting for you to move first.

lines.zh: 这不是武艺，这是它在用我。
lines.en: This isn't skill. It's using me.

lines.zh: 我打中了，可我没想打。
lines.en: I connected, but I didn't mean to.

lines.zh: 这一拳比我自己的重。
lines.en: That punch was heavier than mine.

lines.zh: 手收回来，我赶紧抓住它。
lines.en: The hand comes back; I grab hold of it.

lines.zh: 它打完还在笑。
lines.en: It's still laughing after the blow.

lines.zh: 我偏了一点，本来是冲要害。
lines.en: I turned it aside — it was aimed at a vital point.

lines.zh: 气被它压成一股，很冷。
lines.en: It pressed the ki into one cold stream.

lines.zh: 这一下我抢回来了，只抢回一下。
lines.en: I seized that one back. Only that one.

lines.zh: 连续几击，快得我没反应。
lines.en: Several blows, too fast for me to follow.

lines.zh: 对不起，我拦不住这只手。
lines.en: I'm sorry. I can't stop this hand.

lines.zh: 膝盖弯了，不是我让它弯的。
lines.en: My knee bent. I didn't bend it.

lines.zh: 它在试你的骨头。
lines.en: It's testing your bones.

lines.zh: 我又拿回一瞬，够了。
lines.en: I took back a moment. That's enough.

lines.zh: 它打完就退，很有分寸。
lines.en: It struck and withdrew — very measured.

lines.zh: 我喘着气，声音是我的了。
lines.en: I gasp, and the breath is mine again.

lines.zh: 别再过来了。
lines.en: Don't come any closer.

lines.zh: 我醒过来，可感觉不对。
lines.en: I wake up, and something is wrong.

lines.zh: 这身体站着，我却像躺在里面。
lines.en: The body stands while I lie inside it.

lines.zh: 有东西在我骨头上写字。
lines.en: Something is writing on my bones.

lines.zh: 我抬头，天空的颜色淡了。
lines.en: I look up and the sky looks washed out.

lines.zh: 呼吸是别人的节奏。
lines.en: The rhythm of this breathing isn't mine.

lines.zh: 我的名字，被念成了别的东西。
lines.en: My name got read as something else.

lines.zh: 气从心口往外渗，黑的。
lines.en: Ki seeps from my chest. Black.

lines.zh: 我试着走一步，它替我走了两步。
lines.en: I try one step; it takes two for me.

lines.zh: 这地方我来过，可是想不起来。
lines.en: I've been here, but I can't remember.

lines.zh: 复仇，复仇，一直重复。
lines.en: Revenge, revenge — it repeats and repeats.

lines.zh: 我睁眼的时候，天已经黑了。
lines.en: When I open my eyes, it's already dark.

lines.zh: 别叫我那个名字。
lines.en: Don't call me by that name.

lines.zh: 我把手举起来，看了很久。
lines.en: I raise my hand and stare at it a long time.

lines.zh: 它说这片土地欠了债。
lines.en: It says this land owes a debt.

lines.zh: 我落地的时候，听见两个人的脚步。
lines.en: When I land, I hear two sets of footsteps.

lines.zh: 这具身体的力道，我不认。
lines.en: I don't recognize the strength in this body.

lines.zh: 有人在里面等我让位。
lines.en: Someone inside is waiting for me to step aside.

lines.zh: 这具身体，我还没让出去。
lines.en: I haven't handed this body over yet.

lines.zh: 火在皮上烧，它却不躲。
lines.en: Fire burns my skin, and it won't dodge.

lines.zh: 从高处摔下来，我是先感觉到地的。
lines.en: I fell from height; I felt the ground first.

lines.zh: 水灌进来，它也不肯浮上去。
lines.en: Water pours in, and it won't rise.

lines.zh: 炸开的一瞬，我什么都听不见。
lines.en: For a moment after the blast, I hear nothing.

lines.zh: 有东西扎进来，正好是我那一侧。
lines.en: Something pierced me — my side, of all places.

lines.zh: 这股力在我身体里跟它打架。
lines.en: This force is fighting it inside my body.

lines.zh: 它不管我饿不饿，只借我的力气。
lines.en: It doesn't care if I starve; it just spends my strength.

lines.zh: 雷通过我，我们两个都麻了。
lines.en: Lightning went through me. We both went numb.

lines.zh: 这里什么都没有，连它也不说话。
lines.en: Nothing here — even it has gone silent.
